name: Microsoft Defender for Cloud alerts and recommendations
description: Microsoft Defender for Cloud security alerts and security recommendations, delivered through Azure Event Hubs and indexed by the Splunk Add-on for Microsoft Cloud Services: what was detected or assessed, on which resource, how severe, and what to do about it.
source: Splunk Add-on for Microsoft Cloud Services (mscs_azure_event_hub modular input), sourcetypes mscs:azure:security:alert and mscs:azure:security:recommendation, CIM-mapped to the Alerts data model; Microsoft Defender for Cloud Alerts and Assessments REST API schemas; field presence and CIM alias values confirmed against the dev Splunk instance's own indexed samples

feed.label: Microsoft Defender for Cloud alerts and recommendations
feed.description: Microsoft Defender for Cloud's own findings, exported through Azure Event Hubs: security alerts (one per detection) and security recommendations (one per resource per policy assessment).

vendor_name.label: Vendor name
vendor_name.description: The name of the vendor that raised the alert.

product_name.label: Product name
product_name.description: The Microsoft product or service that published the record: the alert's own product name field, or a fixed label this TA writes for a recommendation.

arm_subscription_id.label: Subscription id
arm_subscription_id.description: The Azure subscription GUID, read out of the /subscriptions/ segment of an Azure Resource Manager id path.
arm_subscription_id.notes: Not itself a named vendor field: every ARM resource id (AzureResourceId, the recommendation's id and resourceDetails.id) carries this segment in the same position.

arm_resource_group.label: Resource group
arm_resource_group.description: The Azure resource group name, read out of the /resourceGroups/ segment of an Azure Resource Manager id path.
arm_resource_group.notes: Not itself a named vendor field; see arm_subscription_id.

alert_type.label: Alert type
alert_type.description: A unique identifier for the detection logic: every alert instance from the same detection shares this value.

alert_description.label: Description
alert_description.description: A description of the suspicious activity that was detected.

alert_severity.label: Severity
alert_severity.description: The risk level Defender for Cloud assigned the detected threat.
alert_severity.notes: The CIM alias lowercases this (Medium becomes medium); the CIM Alerts field of the same name also allows critical and unknown, which this vendor enum does not use.

confidence_level.label: Confidence level
confidence_level.description: An optional coarse confidence rating Microsoft attaches to some alerts.
confidence_level.notes: Null on both of this pack's samples.

confidence_score.label: Confidence score
confidence_score.description: An optional numeric confidence indicator for the alert.
confidence_score.notes: Null on both of this pack's samples.

confidence_reasons.label: Confidence reasons
confidence_reasons.description: An extra field this schema carries alongside confidence_level and confidence_score.

provider_alert_status.label: Provider alert status
provider_alert_status.description: An extra status field this schema carries alongside status.

intent.label: Intent
intent.description: The kill chain stage the alert's detection logic maps to.

is_incident.label: Is incident
is_incident.description: True when the alert is itself a grouping of several related alerts rather than a single alert.

correlation_key.label: Correlation key
correlation_key.description: A key shared by every alert Microsoft considers related to this one.

compromised_entity.label: Compromised entity
compromised_entity.description: The display name of the resource most related to the alert.

azure_resource_id.label: Azure resource id
azure_resource_id.description: The full Azure Resource Manager id of the resource the alert is about.
azure_resource_id.notes: The continuous export payload carries this at the top level as AzureResourceId; the REST alert object instead nests it inside resourceIdentifiers[].azureResourceId (type AzureResource).

workspace_id.label: Log Analytics workspace id
workspace_id.description: The id of the Log Analytics workspace storing this alert, when the alert is tied to one.

workspace_subscription_id.label: Workspace subscription id
workspace_subscription_id.description: The Azure subscription id of the Log Analytics workspace storing this alert.

workspace_resource_group.label: Workspace resource group
workspace_resource_group.description: The resource group of the Log Analytics workspace storing this alert.

agent_id.label: Log Analytics agent id
agent_id.description: The Log Analytics agent id reporting the event the alert is based on.

resource_identifier_type.label: Resource identifier type
resource_identifier_type.description: Which kind of identifier one entry of the alert's resourceIdentifiers list is.

resource_tenant_id.label: Resource tenant id
resource_tenant_id.description: A Microsoft Entra tenant id attached to a resourceIdentifiers entry.
resource_tenant_id.notes: Present on this pack's sample as AzureResourceTenantId (on an AzureResource entry) and AadTenantId (on an entry of type AAD, itself not in the documented enum); neither field is named in the AzureResourceIdentifier or LogAnalyticsIdentifier schema tables.

entities.label: Entities list housekeeping
entities.description: The JSON-schema style $id/$ref back references inside the alert's entities list, used to point one entity at another (for example a process at its host) instead of repeating it.

entity_type.label: Entity type
entity_type.description: Which kind of entity one element of the alert's entities list is.
entity_type.notes: Values below are the ones this pack's own sample carries; the entities list can hold other types the REST doc does not enumerate (Changing set of properties depending on the entity type).

entity_properties.label: Entity properties
entity_properties.description: The remaining fields of one entity: a discriminated bag whose keys follow the sibling Type value (an ip entity carries Address and Location, a process entity carries ProcessId and CommandLine). No single vendor page enumerates every type's field set; each type's own object in the REST schema does.

extended_links.label: Extended links
extended_links.description: Links related to the alert, for example a threat report or a source-code reference the detection logic cited.

extended_properties.label: Extended properties
extended_properties.description: A free-form bag of extra fields relevant to one alert; which keys appear depends on the alert type (this pack's samples show, among others, a Windows process path and PID on one alert and a client IP and application on another).

remediation_steps.label: Remediation steps
remediation_steps.description: Manual action items to take to remediate the alert.

alert_uri.label: Alert URI
alert_uri.description: A direct link to the alert's page in the Azure Portal.

start_time_utc.label: Start time
start_time_utc.description: The UTC time of the first event or activity the alert covers.

end_time_utc.label: End time
end_time_utc.description: The UTC time of the last event or activity the alert covers.

time_generated_utc.label: Time generated
time_generated_utc.description: The UTC time Microsoft generated the alert.

processing_end_time.label: Processing end time
processing_end_time.description: The UTC time Microsoft's processing pipeline finished with this alert.

cim_type.label: CIM record kind
cim_type.description: A fixed word this TA writes to say the record is an alert, for the Alerts data model's own bookkeeping.
cim_type.notes: Not present in the source JSON; constant alert on every indexed event this pack observed.

alert_region.label: Region
alert_region.description: The Azure region named in the alert, read out of the location segment at the end of AlertUri.
alert_region.notes: Correlates exactly with the trailing /location/{region} segment of AlertUri on this pack's sample; absent whenever AlertUri is absent (the second sample).

alert_user.label: Actor user id
alert_user.description: The user involved in the alert event, per the CIM Alerts field of the same name.
alert_user.notes: Empty on both of this pack's samples: neither names an actor through an account entity.

alert_user_name.label: Actor user name
alert_user_name.description: The name of the user involved in the alert event, per the CIM Alerts field of the same name.
alert_user_name.notes: Empty on both of this pack's samples.

alert_dest_type.label: Destination type
alert_dest_type.description: The CIM Alerts category of the alert's target object.
alert_dest_type.notes: instance on this pack's one sample that carries it; absent (not null, missing) on the sample with no ExtendedProperties.resourceType.

alert_src_ip.label: Source address
alert_src_ip.description: An address this TA collects out of the alert's ip-type entities.
alert_src_ip.notes: An array on this pack's sample, with one entry per ip entity (including repeats of the same address); not deduplicated.

assessment_key.label: Assessment key
assessment_key.description: The assessment type's key (the record's own name property): the same value for every resource that assessment type ran against. The unique id for one finding is the full ARM path in the record's top level id property, seen only in _raw on this sourcetype, not extracted to a field of its own.

assessment_resource_type.label: Resource type constant
assessment_resource_type.description: A fixed value, Microsoft.Security/assessments, naming the ARM resource type of every record on this sourcetype.

resource_details_source.label: Resource details source
resource_details_source.description: The platform the assessed resource lives on.

resource_details_id.label: Assessed resource id
resource_details_id.description: The ARM resource id of the resource this assessment scored.

assessment_display_name.label: Assessment display name
assessment_display_name.description: A user friendly display name of the assessment (the recommendation's title).

assessment_status_code.label: Assessment status code
assessment_status_code.description: A programmatic code for the result of the assessment.

assessment_status_cause.label: Assessment status cause
assessment_status_cause.description: A programmatic code for why the assessment has that status.
assessment_status_cause.notes: The schema table gives no fixed list of cause values; OffByPolicy is this pack's one observed value.

assessment_status_description.label: Assessment status description
assessment_status_description.description: A human readable description of the assessment status.

linked_workspace_id.label: Linked workspace id
linked_workspace_id.description: A Log Analytics workspace id associated with the assessment.
linked_workspace_id.notes: Seen in the vendor's own worked example under additionalData, a field the schema table documents only as an untyped object, not by key name.

assessment_metadata.label: Assessment metadata fields
assessment_metadata.description: Severity, a free-text description, a remediation description and a policy definition id that SecurityAssessmentMetadataProperties documents, aliased onto this sourcetype's CIM shape (severity, description, recommendation, signature_id).

mscs:azure:security:alert.description: Microsoft Defender for Cloud security alerts, delivered through Azure Event Hubs and indexed by the Splunk Add-on for Microsoft Cloud Services (mscs_azure_event_hub), one flat JSON object per alert, CIM-mapped to the Alerts data model.
mscs:azure:security:alert.note: Entities, ExtendedLinks and ResourceIdentifiers are JSON arrays, flattened to dotted and bracketed field names (Entities{}.Type, ResourceIdentifiers{}.Type). ExtendedProperties keys contain spaces (ExtendedProperties.Client IP address). _time is set from StartTimeUtc; index_time_ok is false in this pack's own sample metadata.

mscs:azure:security:recommendation.description: Microsoft Defender for Cloud security recommendations (Microsoft.Security/assessments), delivered through Azure Event Hubs and indexed by the same modular input, one flat ARM assessment resource object per record, CIM-mapped to the Alerts data model.
mscs:azure:security:recommendation.note: No field on the record carries an event time; _time is index time (index_time_ok is true in this pack's own sample metadata). properties.metadata is absent from every example this pack found, so severity, description, recommendation and signature_id are consistently null.

four_alert_times.text: An alert carries four UTC times: StartTimeUtc/EndTimeUtc bound the activity, TimeGenerated is when Microsoft raised the alert, ProcessingEndTime is when the export pipeline finished. This pack's own sample entry sets _time from StartTimeUtc and marks index_time_ok false, so _time is not ingestion time and not TimeGenerated.

assessment_key_shared.text: The recommendation record's name (and the CIM id alias of it) is the assessment type's key: the same GUID names every resource that check ran against, seen here identically on the vmss1 and vmss2 samples. The unique key for one finding is the record's own top level id, the full ARM path.

resource_id_case.text: AzureResourceId arrives cased however the source cased it: SUBSCRIPTIONS and RESOURCEGROUPS upper case in one sample, lower case in another. A literal string match against ResourceIdentifiers or resourceDetails ids needs a case fold first.

metadata_absent.text: severity, description, recommendation and signature_id on the recommendation sourcetype are TA aliases of the assessment's metadata (severity, description, remediationDescription), which only the $expand=metadata call returns. No example on the vendor's Get or List pages carries it, and neither does any sample this pack indexed; expect these four fields null.

resource_identifier_type_extra.text: The alert sample carries a resourceIdentifier of type AAD (AadTenantId only), which the documented ResourceIdentifierType enum does not list (it names only AzureResource and LogAnalytics).

product_name_renamed.text: ProductName appears as both Microsoft Defender for Cloud and the legacy Azure Security Center across this pack's own two alert samples: the product was renamed, the field was not backfilled.

status_undocumented_value.text: Both of this pack's alert samples carry Status New, a value the documented AlertStatus enum does not list (it names only Active, InProgress, Resolved, Dismissed).

friendly_name_not_id.text: A display name for a resource, not a stable id: it can repeat and can change on rename. Pivot on the record's own id or the ARM resource id, not this field.
